title: Agenda Manager / Creator

scenarios.title: Built-in Standard Agenda contract
scenarios.expected: The built-in Standard Agenda remains available on a clean profile, stays inside a 16:9 slide, and is not persisted/duplicated as user data.

scenarios.title: Rendered time slots are start to end
scenarios.expected: A 15-minute item starting at 09:00 renders exactly 09:00 - 09:15 and consecutive rows remain monotonic.

scenarios.title: Standard Agenda has no unexplained page-number column
scenarios.expected: The default Standard Agenda does not render unlabeled page-number metadata; custom layouts can still opt into page references.

scenarios.title: Agenda update preserves content ownership
scenarios.expected: Rename/reorder/add/update keeps normal content slides, avoids duplication/loss, and remains editable after save/reopen.

scenarios.title: Standard Agenda visual sanity
scenarios.expected: The generated sample reads as a normal business agenda: no stray right-edge numbers, correct time direction, clear hierarchy and restrained current-item emphasis.
ownerSteps: Generate the built-in Standard Agenda in a 16:9 deck with at least three main items and two sub-items.
Inspect the right metadata area, time ranges, hierarchy and current-item highlight.
Save, reopen and confirm the same visual structure.
